# exo_mailbox_irm_access (Data Source)

Look up an existing MailboxIRMAccess object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `access_level` (String) Maps to the -AccessLevel parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `user` (String) Maps to the -User parameter.
